findings.stable_content: Across the accessible Qurtubi renditions, Islam is list item five and the clause uses حکاه المغيرة / حكاه المغيرة.
findings.edition_locator_variance: Printed page locators differ by edition or digitization: KetabOnline labels p.216, while IslamWeb labels p.193. The locator must retain its source edition; these are not interchangeable page numbers.
findings.attribution_limit: All three witnesses name only al-Mughira. None inspected here expands his identity, says he originated or adopted the interpretation, or provides an oral transmission route.
findings.preference_limit: Qurtubi's subsequent explicit preference is restricted to the first and second readings; the fifth item is not thereby his own preferred position.
findings.english_limit: These Arabic editions do not identify the provenance of the stored English row; the corresponding meaning remains absent in live row 38030.

decision: This corroborates the Arabic wording and source-local ordinal for Q04C; keep the separate reporter voice representation and semantic hold pending independent human review. Do not alter live Arabic/English or import the external English parallel.
